subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as the public native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents` completion-routing contract, including parent-only delivery with no channel fallback?
rationale: The code is coherent and proven, but it creates model-facing, operator-configurable, and durable message-delivery semantics whose permanent API and failure behavior require maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
options.body: Land the complete tool/config/state contract with `channel` unchanged as the default and parent failure remaining non-fallback.

options.title: Start per-spawn only
options.body: Land only the explicit `sessions_spawn` parameter and defer global/per-agent defaults to reduce the initial compatibility surface.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open if maintainers are not ready to support parent-only completion routing as a stable contract.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
recommendation.body: Land the complete tool/config/state contract with `channel` unchanged as the default and parent failure remaining non-fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history signal across the subagent spawn, delivery, lifecycle, and tool-contract surfaces.
